reviews.text: Had Juan and his guys replaced some fence for me. Reasonable price, the Work turned out good and cleaned up the area well. Nothing but good things to say and would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Jason Lee

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Accessories Fence & Deck. The final product is absolutely amazing — it exceeded my expectations. They were flexible and easy to work with, and they handled all of my special requests without any trouble.
Even when I couldn’t be on site, they kept me updated by sending photos of the progress, which gave me confidence in the work and allowed me to ask questions along the way.
I’m thrilled with the results and highly recommend Accessories Fence & Deck to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship and excellent service.
reviews.author: Scott Schley

reviews.text: Our experience with Juan and his crew was great.  It started with Juan coming over to provide an estimate and taking the time to describe different types of wood and fencing, and various options. He was personable and knowledgeable and made the experience feel very personalized. He tore down our old 8ft tall privacy fence and RV gate and installed a new one with better supports and stained the shade we wanted in just 3 days. He also created a new side gate for us. The job came out beautifully and my husband and I are thrilled!
reviews.author: Arienda Zamora

reviews.text: Excellent workmanship & even better professionalism...... Juan came out on a moments notice & did an amazing job on replacing deck posts & dead/ rotten wood.  Did I mention that he finished this job on mother's day!!!!! Highly recommended 👌🏿
reviews.author: James Glenn

reviews.text:
Juan and Cesar are STAND UP GUYS!! They built 2 beautiful and SOLID (FOR OUR HANDICAPPED FAMILY) sets of stairs for our Modular Home.

Juan and Cesar were ON TIME, friendly, courteous , listened and built the stairs to our deck as our community requires while keeping in mind our physical needs for safety.

The big name ACE in the HOLE companies tried to rob us blind with cedar when we didn't need it because we are no where near water ways.

Juan took my concerns and needs to heart and worked in my family's budget.

We HIGHLY recommend Accessory Fence and Decks to anyone needing Deck Work for Quality of Work/Value for the money.

God bless you and your families Juan and Cesar.......

We are EXTREMELY GRATEFUL for keeping us safe while providing  well crafted stairs for our deck here in Euless, Texas
reviews.author: Jack Whye

reviews.text: The Accessory Fence and Deck Company did an outstanding job installing my patio enclosure.  They completed the work in a timely manner.  The team was very cordial and kind.  The work that was done went beyond my expectation!  I highly recommend the company!
reviews.author: Wyteria Curley

reviews.text: I contracted with Juan and Accessory to replace the old wood stairs and small landings with new premium grade Western Red Cedar.  I am very pleased with the results.  It appears to be excellent quality workmanship and was completed in three days as estimated.  Jaan was helpful in small redesign changes that improved the utility of the landings.  He was able to relocate some electrical outlets, both 110 and 220. that will be useful in the future.  I would highly recommend Accessory.  Five Stars.
